title: PQ typed reward classification correction

corrections.before: This place Will be your grave!
corrections.after: This place will be your grave!
corrections.basis: Canonical Super Soul endpoint exists with lowercase 'will'; the forward PQ reward used a source-text capitalization variant. The existing canonical PQ relationship already targets the lowercase endpoint.

God of Destruction's Might is a canonical skill endpoint and is already represented in pq-176 skill_rewards. It was not retained as a Super Soul merely because the same string appeared in the general reward list.

validation_intent: No new relationship edge was inferred.
No drop probability, guarantee, or Ultimate-Finish-only status was inferred.
Canonical forward PQ data remains authoritative over reverse indexes and verified/index projections.
resulting_boundary: The remaining PQ Super Soul forward mismatches are endpoint-inventory gaps for named rewards Take care...of your mother... and I will defeat you!; they remain unresolved because no canonical endpoint was established.
PQ164 is no longer a spelling-only forward parity mismatch.
PQ176 no longer has a cross-domain type collision between skill_rewards and super_soul_rewards.
